import json,re
from pathlib import Path
D=json.loads(Path('store/jobs/j000347/stdout.log').read_text()); needle=b'userkey'; counts={}; candidates=[]; per=[]
for it in D['hits']:
 p=Path(it['path']); b=p.read_bytes(); lo=b.lower(); local={}; n=0
 for enc,q in [('ascii',needle),('utf16le',b''.join(bytes([x,0]) for x in needle))]:
  pos=0
  while (i:=lo.find(q,pos))>=0:
   n+=1; c=b[max(0,i-100):min(len(b),i+len(q)+180)]
   # Get plain ASCII window only for classification. Do not emit or store candidate key bytes.
   t=c.decode('latin1','replace').lower().replace('\x00','')
   if re.search(r'userkey\s*[:=]\s*[^\s,;\]}]{1,}',t): cat='explicit assignment pattern (needs provenance/authentication)'
   elif 'cryptgetuserkey' in t: cat='Windows CryptGetUserKey API/source vocabulary'
   elif 'currentuserkeypath' in t or 'builduserpath' in t: cat='Windows registry/user-key API vocabulary'
   elif str(p).endswith('/job.json'): cat='job command/input metadata echo'
   elif any(x in str(p) for x in ('report-snapshot','checkpoint-redaction-snapshot')): cat='report/checkpoint echo'
   elif str(p).endswith('stdout.log') or 'tool-output' in str(p): cat='tool/search output echo'
   elif str(p).endswith('dropbox-contexts.jsonl'): cat='earlier contextual search result (binary API/runtime strings)'
   elif '/out/' in str(p) and any(s in str(p).lower() for s in ('metrics','summary','audit','context','hit','ascii','utf16')): cat='derived search/strings result; no authentication from label'
   else: cat='other literal-context hit; requires content/provenance, not proof of key value'
   local[cat]=local.get(cat,0)+1
   if cat=='explicit assignment pattern (needs provenance/authentication)': candidates.append(str(p))
   pos=i+len(q)
 for k,v in local.items():counts[k]=counts.get(k,0)+v
 per.append({'path':str(p),'hits':n,'classes':local})
print(json.dumps({'needle':'userkey','files':len(per),'occurrences':sum(x['hits'] for x in per),'class_totals':counts,'explicit_assignment_occurrences':len(candidates),'explicit_assignment_objects':sorted(set(candidates)),'per_object':per},indent=2))
